concerns.text: T001C DEPENDS ON T001A, T001B - this dependency is not reflected in the order of the tasks. T001A and T001B should precede T001C to ensure the directory structure is created before the init script runs.
T006 DEPENDS ON T005 - this dependency is not reflected in the order of the tasks. T005 should precede T006 to ensure the schema file is created before the validator is implemented.

T014A lists 'Action' items that are essentially implementation details. While helpful, this clutters the task list. Consider moving detailed actions to a separate documentation section or internal notes.
T015B's description is very detailed and reads more like implementation notes than a task description. Simplify to focus on the *what* not the *how*.
T031's description is lengthy and complex. Break it down into smaller, more manageable sub-tasks if possible. The conditional logic around baseline loading is particularly dense.
